## Summary

The epic scope names Band alongside Reflector. Check whether Band has a maintained Soroban deployment and interface; if it does, specify an adapter behind the same client shape, and if not, record the decision to defer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The study links the deployed contract (or states that none exists) on testnet and mainnet.
- [ ] If feasible, it specifies the adapter interface; if not, it records what would have to change for a later revisit.
